purpose: Test whether the decisive within-node anchor-TNC association survives adjustment for contemporaneous same-meter water depth, reducing persistent meter-mark microhabitat confounding.
required_extra_measurement: baseline_depth_m at the same permanent meter mark and baseline survey as baseline_bb_anchor
hierarchy: The original within-node anchor-TNC model remains the decisive primary.
This depth-adjusted sensitivity cannot rescue an unsupported primary.
A supported primary that remains positive after depth adjustment weakens, but does not eliminate, persistent meter-mark microhabitat confounding.
If depth coverage falls below the frozen replication gate, report this sensitivity as non-estimable without changing thresholds.
claim_boundary: Same-meter depth is one measured microhabitat covariate; substrate, direct light, hydrodynamics and other local common causes remain possible.
A supported depth-adjusted TNC coefficient is prospective state-augmentation evidence, not proof that carbohydrate causally buffers decline.
